description: Use this when the user wants several invoices in one spreadsheet ("put these invoices into Excel", "invoice log from these PDFs", "purchase ledger", "VAT summary by rate", "check these invoices for duplicates"). Send the invoices as rows when their values are in the chat or a screenshot; send attached invoice PDFs (selectable text) in files; send pasted invoice text in invoice_texts (one string per invoice), and use text only as a fallback. Returns an Excel ledger (supplier, invoice number, invoice and due date, currency, net, tax per rate, tax total, gross, status) with By supplier, By tax rate and Checks sheets, and a CSV. Flags totals that do not equal net + tax, tax that does not match its rate, and duplicate invoice numbers per supplier. Reads header totals only, not line items. Does not read scanned images, convert currencies, file tax returns, or say whether tax is reclaimable.

currency.description: Currency for invoices that show none, as an ISO code, e.g. USD. A code printed on the invoice wins.

date_order.description: Order of numeric dates such as 03/04/2026: DMY (UK, EU) or MDY (US). Detected when a day is above 12.

decimal_mark.description: Decimal mark of the amounts: "." (1,234.56) or "," (1.234,56). Detected per invoice when omitted.

files.description: Invoice PDFs with selectable text (not scans), up to 20, e.g. acme-inv-1001.pdf, northwind-re-77.pdf. A .txt with pasted invoice text also works.

download_url.description: Temporary download link for the file, supplied by ChatGPT.

file_name.description: Original file name if known, e.g. statement.pdf.

mime_type.description: Media type if known, e.g. application/pdf.

invoice_texts.description:
Pasted invoice text, one string per invoice, e.g. ["Acme Supplies Ltd
Invoice No: INV-2044
Invoice Date: 14/10/2026
Subtotal £2,400.00
VAT 20% £480.00
Total £2,880.00"].

amount_due.description: Amount due if it differs from the total (part paid), e.g. 500.00.

currency.description: ISO currency code, e.g. GBP. Defaults to the currency argument.

due_date.description: Payment due date if printed, e.g. 2026-10-31.

invoice_number.description: Invoice number exactly as printed, e.g. INV-1001.

net.description: Net amount before tax (subtotal), e.g. 1250.00 or "1.250,00".

supplier.description: Supplier name as printed, e.g. Acme Supplies Ltd.

tax.description: Total tax amount if one rate, e.g. 250.00.

net.description: Taxable base at this rate, e.g. 100.00.

tax_lines.description: Several tax rates on one invoice, e.g. [{"rate":5.5,"net":100,"tax":5.5},{"rate":20,"net":41.67,"tax":8.33}].

tax_rate.description: Tax rate in percent if one rate, e.g. 20 (not 0.2).

invoices.description: Invoices as rows, one per invoice, e.g. [{"supplier":"Acme Supplies Ltd","invoice_number":"INV-1001","invoice_date":"2026-10-01","currency":"GBP","net":1250,"tax_rate":20,"gross":1500}]. Use this when the invoice values are in the chat or a screenshot.

text.description: Fallback only: several invoices pasted as one text; they are split at --- lines or where a new invoice number starts.

name: generate_invoice_ledger
title: Generate invoice ledger
